title: Y/T Junction — Pascal Thread Multiplicity — 11x11 Bridge
boundaries: 121=11^2 is the base-10 instance of a general radix identity.
An 11x11 grid also has 121 cells, but numerical equality does not prove structural identity.
Y and T are topologically equal only while their incidence relation is unchanged.
The mod-7 layer is a residue quotient; no musical or physical interpretation was tested.
One thread is a path through the grid; multiplicity counts how many paths reach a node.
